blocks.text: Woh reactions jin mein reactants poori tarah kharch ho kar products mein badal jayein na-wapas (irreversible) hain; woh limiting reactant kharch hone par ruk jati hain. Magar kuch reactions maujooda halaat mein reactants aur products ki concentration badle baghair dono simton, forward aur reverse, mein jari rehti hain; aisi reactions kabhi nahi rukti aur reversible reactions kehlati hain. Jab reversible reaction aise bartan mein ho jo shamil kisi bhi madde ke dakhil hone ya nikalne se rokta ho, to ajza ki miqdarein badalti hain jaise kuch kharch aur kuch bante hain, jab tak reaction chemical equilibrium tak na pohnche: reactants aur products ki concentrations mustaqil ho jati hain aur forward aur reverse reactions ki rates barabar. Reversible reactions ki misalein, dohre teer ke saath, N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3, 2NO2 se N2O4, aur PCl5 se PCl3 + Cl2 hain.
Reaction ke waqiat do paimanon par bayan ho sakte hain: macroscopic waqiat, jo dekhe ja sakte hain, aur microscopic waqiat, jo nahi. Agle do topics har ek ki tareef karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Irreversible reaction kyun ruk jati hai jabke reversible kabhi nahi rukti?
blocks.explanation: Irreversible reaction sirf ek taraf chalti hai, to apna limiting reactant kharch hone par khatam ho jati hai. Reversible reaction mein products bhi react kar ke reactants dobara banate hain; dono mukhalif reactions molecular satah par jari rehti hain, aur equilibrium par woh bas barabar ho jati hain, to reaction asal mein kabhi nahi rukti.

items: Irreversible reactions limiting reactant kharch hone par rukti hain; reversible reactions (dohra teer: N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3, 2NO2 se N2O4, PCl5 se PCl3 + Cl2) dono taraf chalti aur band bartan mein chemical equilibrium tak pohnchti hain, jahan concentrations mustaqil aur forward aur reverse rates barabar hain.
